name: SEO Audit & Alerts
description: Know where your site stands in Google and hear about it the day something goes wrong. Describe the site once, connect Search Console and a mailbox, get a full audit (crawl, mobile speed, indexing, search demand) with a report, a score out of 100 and a prioritized list of actions on a GitHub board, a Jira project or a shared Google Sheet. A weekly check-up then watches the site without ever changing it and emails you only when the score drops, traffic falls, a key page leaves Google's index, a page breaks or speed regresses, plus a short monthly summary. Any site, on a Git repository or a CMS; one-shot audits of any other site as an Excel workbook.
